# Niyyah

> Niyyah is a mobile app (iOS and Android) for Muslims who are looking for a spouse, built around Islamic limits: only the opposite gender, messages open only on mutual interest, an optional mahram (family member) in the conversation, and a moderated community. Made in Bosnia and Herzegovina. Tagline: "Brak, tražen s namjerom." (Marriage, sought with intention.)

Niyyah means "intention". The app is built for marriage, not for browsing. It is not yet in the App Store or Google Play; the site has a waitlist.

## What the app does

- Discover shows only the opposite gender. This is a server rule, not a filter.
- Messages open only when both people like each other. One short introductory message can be sent from Discover, but it waits and is delivered only after a match.
- Mahram portal: a woman can turn on "Require a mahram" and invite up to three people (father, brother, uncle, guardian or another mahram) by email. They see her conversations and matches in a read-only portal; they cannot write and do not use the app to meet anyone. One mahram can look after several people. Available on women's profiles.
- Questions before chatting: a user sets up to three questions; after a match the other person answers first, and the user decides whether the conversation opens.
- Profiles include relationship with faith, prayer, madhhab, hijab, timeframe for marriage, willingness to move, children, and answers to "Situations" in seven areas (marriage, communication, conflict, family, faith, finances, parenting).
- Safety: exact location is never shown; photos are checked on upload and EXIF/GPS data is removed; phone or email verification before Discover; optional Verified badge; reports are read by real moderators; blocking works both ways; Discover can be paused.
- Community: moderated posts (every post is reviewed before it appears), separate spaces visible to one gender only, anonymous questions.
- Languages: the app is in 9 languages — Bosnian, English, German, Turkish, Arabic, Indonesian, Urdu, Malay and French.
- Free: profile, Discover, 20 likes a day, 1 introductory message a day, unlimited chat with matches, mahram, questions before chatting, community. Premium adds seeing who liked you, unlimited likes and introductory messages, extra filters, and replying to stories.

Niyyah does not issue fatwas and does not claim approval from any religious institution.

## Guide

- [Who is a mahram](https://niyyahmarriage.com/en/guide/who-is-a-mahram): who counts as a mahram, how a mahram differs from a wali, and the mahram's role when looking for a spouse
- [Is it halal to look for a spouse through an app?](https://niyyahmarriage.com/en/guide/is-a-muslim-marriage-app-halal): what Islam asks of people getting to know each other for marriage
- [Questions to ask before marriage](https://niyyahmarriage.com/en/guide/questions-to-ask-before-marriage): faith, children, moving, money, family
- [Vodič (Bosnian guide)](https://niyyahmarriage.com/vodic): also covers nikah conditions, wali and mahr; how to look for a spouse in Islam; a guide for parents
- [Ratgeber (German guide)](https://niyyahmarriage.com/de/ratgeber)
- [Rehber (Turkish guide)](https://niyyahmarriage.com/tr/rehber)
